events.title: Development Update
events.summary: Hi everyone! I wanted to share a new feature I've been developing, AI chats! Computer players have the ability to send you various little taunts and messages throughout the game. They range from basic little messages just saying hello to scouting advice or messages asking for help defending their base. It's a feature I really like, and I think it really adds a lot more personality to the AI players you play against while also providing a lot of useful info, especially in team games.

events.title: Development Update
events.summary: Good Morning Everyone!There's quite a lot going on behind the scenes, but I want to focus on the new reworked loadout selection system. My goal is to streamline the unit selection process and simplify choices by providing more structure to the loadout composition. In the new system in each slot on the left hand side corresponds to a unit series, where you can select from a small set of choices within that series. events.title: Development Update
events.summary: Good Afternoon Everyone!Let's go over the three basic types of aircraft. We have fighter planes, attack planes, and gunships. All of them train from an airfield and have some similar mechanics to know about.Shared MechanicsAircraft all have the same basic mechanics. They train from an airfield, and once they run out of ammo they have to return to an airfield to resupply. Airfields also repair damaged aircraft, so players can return them early if needed.
